decision_record.transfer: The sleeve's designed edge is computed on completed bars (desk convention, sleeves/momentum.py last_completed); a forming bar is a partial, revisable print — decisions taken on it pay real spread/slippage for a signal that may not exist at the close.
decision_record.comparison: Same-pass paired A/B: treatment (completed bars only) vs shadow control (untrimmed view) evaluated on identical opportunities in a throwaway state dir; control intents never emitted.
decision_record.mechanism: The -40% circuit breaker (and book-notional reference) read bl[-1] raw while rank/pricing filter through last_completed — the sleeve's own completed-bar law. A forming bar dipping 40% under entry fires an exit the completed series does not support.
decision_record.calculation: Fixture A/B: 139 completed bars 200->130 (breaker level 120), forming session bar at 100, held 3 @ 200. Control (switch OFF): 1 breaker exit. Treatment (ON): no exit.
